evals.name: messy-resume-odd-skills
evals.prompt:
Build the resume for this synthetic candidate.

SYNTHETIC CANDIDATE K
CNC Machinist / Manufacturing Tech
Exampleton MI

Profile: 9 yrs running CNC mills and lathes, good with GD&T, lean guy, trained other operators.

Skills: CNC Milling, CNC Turning, GD&T, Lean Manufacturing, Mastercam, Quality Inspection, Blueprint Reading

Work:
Example Precision Parts Co, Exampleton MI, 2018-now, Senior CNC Machinist. cut scrap rate from 8% to 3%, ran lights-out program saving like 15 hrs a week, trained 4 new operators.
Example Tooling Co, Sampleville MI, 2015 to 2018, CNC Operator. ran 3 machines at once, hit 98% on time.

evals.name: unstructured-interview-notes
evals.prompt:
Turn my call notes into a resume PDF for this synthetic candidate.

Talked to Synthetic Candidate F today. Mechanical engineer, about 12 years. Currently at Example Industrial Ltd. in Exampleton as a Manufacturing Engineering Manager, been there since early 2019. Before that she was a Process Engineer at Example Process Systems Ltd. in Sampleville from 2013 to 2019. She leads a team of 8 now. Big wins: led a plant automation project that cut cycle time 22%, ran the ISO 9001 recert, owns the capital equipment budget around 4 million. She's a Six Sigma Black Belt. Degree is BSME from Example University. Really strong on lean, process optimization, automation, project management, and she does a lot of cross functional leadership. Target role is Operations / Plant Manager.
evals.expected_output: Apps Script with CANDIDATE filled from unstructured notes. Summary written (2-4 sentences), even skill count, two roles most-recent-first with mmm-yyyy dates, quantified bullets, education line. Fixed format constants untouched.

evals.name: missing-data-no-invent
evals.prompt:
Make this into a resume for me.

Synthetic Candidate G - Quality Manager. Worked at a Tier 1 auto supplier (can't remember exact name, will confirm) running the quality department. Did APQP, PPAP, managed the audit program, ISO/TS 16949. Reduced customer complaints a lot. Has an engineering degree. Not sure on exact employment dates yet.
